description:
## Features

Ported from [Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches).

### YouTube
- **DeArrow titles:** Replace clickbait titles with DeArrow's community titles, set per screen (Home, Player playlists & recommendations, Search results, Subscriptions, You), with an optional DeArrow icon and a "Casual mode" that keeps the original title when enough DeArrow users prefer it. Settings: RVX → Alternative thumbnails.
- **Caption language:** Pick a preferred caption language. Creator subtitles are used first, then a track already in that language, then an auto-translated track. It also adds more auto-translate languages. Settings: RVX → General.
- **Disable "Continue watching?" prompt:** Autoplay keeps going instead of pausing with a "Continue watching?" prompt after a period of inactivity. Settings: RVX → Player.
- **Picture-in-picture button:** A new overlay button in the video player enters picture-in-picture. Settings: RVX → Player → Player buttons.

## Notes
- DeArrow titles and the preferred caption language need an app restart after changing them.
- With "Restore original titles" also on, a DeArrow title is used when the video has one, otherwise the original title.
- Choosing a track in the captions menu still wins for that video.
- Extra auto-translate languages are only added when YouTube offers fewer than the full list for a video.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.8.0...v1.9.0)
